title.narrative: Improving agro-industrial value chain and supervision capacity in Quannan, China

description.narrative: UNIDO was implementing the Project #Improving agro-industrial practice and capacity for poverty alleviation in Quannan, China# during May 2019 to December 2021 to improve the capacity, productivity and quality of the agricultural and food production and processing sector in Quannan for the contribution to China#s national poverty alleviation strategies and policies. The Project implementation has reached tremendous fruitful results benefiting local residents, agro-producing and processing as enterprises and farmers# cooperatives, youth and women, governmental institutes, consumers etc. From the impact reached by the Project, the local counterpart invited UNIDO to develop a second-phase project to continue the support and contribution to improving agro-industrial value chain and supervision capacity in Quannan, based on the foundation the first-phase project has established on agro value chain development and food safety assurance.
